blurb: Sumter Equestrian Center is an equestrian facility in Bushnell, Florida serving riders, families, trainers, and spectators. The site offers two large arenas for competitions and practices. Regular schooling is available outside of show days, and the center hosts hunter jumper, dressage, and ranch horse events, as well as special days like Farm City Day. The facility provides on-site 10' x 10' stalls with shavings for competitors and has space for both competitors and spectators.
extraNote: No open fires · If you open a gate or door, close it. If you turn it on, turn it off. If you break something, please report it so we can fix it.
